changelog.name: YaMusicLsposed 1.0 - Inital Release for Vector (LSPosed) repo
changelog.body:
# EN
### First release of YaMusicLsposed!

**What's new:**
* **Direct download**: Download tracks, albums, and playlists in original quality.
* **Parallel download**: Maximum speed thanks to downloading in 4 threads.
* **Liquid Glass user interface**: Premium Jetpack Compose interface design with smooth animations.
* **Metadata embedding**: All tracks are downloaded with high-quality cover art and ID3 tags.
* **Smart sorting**: File creation dates are adjusted to ensure they are perfectly sorted by playlist order in any player.
* **Active downloads**: Convenient overlay with a tracker that prioritizes newly downloaded tracks.

 **How ​​to install:**
1. Install the attached `YaMusicLsposed-Release-1.0.apk`
2. Activate the module in the LSPosed manager.
3. Check the Yandex Music app.
4. Restart Yandex Music.

# RU
### Первый релиз YaMusicLsposed!

**Что нового:**
* **Прямое скачивание**: Скачивание треков, альбомов и плейлистов в оригинальном качестве.
* **Параллельная загрузка**: Максимальная скорость благодаря скачиванию в 4 потока.
* **Liquid Glass UI**: Премиальный дизайн интерфейса на Jetpack Compose с плавными анимациями.
* **Вшивание метаданных**: Все треки скачиваются с обложками в высоком качестве и правильными ID3-тегами.
* **Умная сортировка**: Дата создания файлов подменяется так, чтобы они идеально сортировались по порядку плейлиста в любом плеере.
* **Активные загрузки**: Удобный оверлей с трекером загружаемых треков в реальном времени.

**Как установить:**
1. Установите прикрепленный `YaMusicLsposed-Release-1.0.apk`
2. Активируйте модуль в менеджере LSPosed.
3. Поставьте галочку на приложение Яндекс Музыка.
4. Перезапустите Яндекс Музыку.

# YaMusicLsposed **A powerful LSPosed module for the Yandex Music app** [![Kotlin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Kotlin-1.9-blue.svg?logo=kotlin)](http://kotlinlang.org) [![LSPosed](https://img.shields.io/badge/LSPosed-Supported-brightgreen.svg)](https://github.com/LSPosed/LSPosed) [English](README.md) | [Русский](README_RU.md)
--- **YaMusicLsposed** is an Xposed/LSPosed module that adds music downloading capabilities and advanced features to the official Yandex Music application. The module works entirely "under the hood" and integrates seamlessly into the app's UI with a stunning Liquid Glass design. ## Features * **Direct MP3 Download**: Download individual tracks, entire albums, or playlists in original quality. * **Embedded Metadata & Covers**: Tracks are saved with correct ID3 tags (Title, Artist, Album) and high-quality album art embedded. * **Parallel Downloading**: Super-fast playlist downloads using multiple threads. * **Playlist Sorting**: The module smartly manipulates file creation dates so that when sorting files by "Date Added" in your player, they align perfectly with the original playlist order. * **Liquid Glass UI**: Premium settings and overlay menus built with Jetpack Compose featuring a translucent glass effect, fluid animations, and native back gesture support. * **Active Downloads Monitor**: A convenient real-time tracker showing the progress of each individual track currently being downloaded. ## Installation 1. Ensure your device is rooted with **Magisk / KernelSU** and has the **LSPosed** framework installed. 2. Install the [Yandex Music](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ru.yandex.music) app from Google Play. 3. Download the latest **YaMusicLsposed** from the [Releases](../../releases) page. 4. Install the module's APK. 5. Open the LSPosed Manager, enable the module, and check the "Yandex Music" app. 6. Restart Yandex Music (or force stop it from system settings). ## Usage * **Download a track**: Tap the download icon in the player (next to playback controls). * **Download a playlist/album**: Tap the download icon on the playlist or album page. * **Settings**: Long-press the single-track download button. Here you can configure the save folder, audio quality, and token. * **Active Downloads**: Long-press the playlist/album download button. This opens a beautiful overlay showing all currently downloading tracks. ## Contact Me (Windyx0) - [Telegram Channel](https://t.me/WindyxChannel) - [Telegram DM](https://t.me/Windyx0) - [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@windyx_edits) ## License This project is licensed under the MIT License. You are free to use, modify, and distribute the code. See the [LICENSE](LICENSE) file for more details. *Disclaimer: This project is created for educational purposes. Please respect copyright laws and use this module only to download content to which you have legal access.*
readmeZh: #YaMusicLspose **适用于 Yandex Music 应用程序的强大 LSPod 模块** [![Kotlin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Kotlin-1.9-blue.svg?logo=kotlin)](http://kotlinlang.org) [![LSPosed](https://img.shields.io/badge/LSPosed-Supported-brightgreen.svg)](https://github.com/LSPosed/LSPosed) [中文](README.md) | [Русский](README_RU.md) --- **YaMusicLspond** 是一个 Xposed/LSPosed 模块，为官方 Yandex Music 应用程序添加了音乐下载功能和高级功能。该模块完全在“后台”工作，并通过令人惊叹的液体玻璃设计无缝集成到应用程序的用户界面中。 ## 特点 * **直接 MP3 下载**：以原始质量下载单个曲目、整个专辑或播放列表。 * **嵌入式元数据和封面**：曲目使用正确的 ID3 标签（标题、艺术家、专辑）和嵌入的高质量专辑艺术进行保存。 * **并行下载**：使用多线程超快速播放列表下载。 * **播放列表排序**：该模块智能地操作文件创建日期，以便在播放器中按“添加日期”对文件进行排序时，它们与原始播放列表顺序完美对齐。 * **液体玻璃 UI**：使用 Jetpack Compose 构建的高级设置和覆盖菜单，具有半透明玻璃效果、流畅的动画和原生背部手势支持。 * **活动下载监视器**：一个方便的实时跟踪器，显示当前正在下载的每个单独曲目的进度。 ## 安装 1. 确保您的设备已通过 **Magisk / KernelSU** 获取 root 权限并安装 **LSPosed** 框架。 2. 从 Google Play 安装 [Yandex Music](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ru.yandex.music) 应用程序。 3. 从 [Releases](../../releases) 页面下载最新的 **YaMusicLsspoke**。 4. 安装模块的APK。 5. 打开 LSPod Manager，启用该模块，然后选中“Yandex Music”应用程序。 6. 重新启动 Yandex Music（或从系统设置中强制停止它）。 ## 用法 * **下载曲目**：点击播放器中的下载图标（播放控件旁边）。 * **下载播放列表/专辑**：点击播放列表或专辑页面上的下载图标。 * **设置**：长按单曲下载按钮。您可以在此处配置保存文件夹、音频质量和令牌。 * **主动下载**：长按播放列表/专辑下载按钮。这将打开一个漂亮的叠加层，显示所有当前下载的曲目。 ## 联系我 (Windyx0) - [电报频道](https://t.me/WindyxChannel) - [电报DM](https://t.me/Windyx0) - [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@windyx_edits) ## 许可证 该项目已获得 MIT 许可证的许可。您可以自由使用、修改和分发代码。有关更多详细信息，请参阅 [LICENSE](LICENSE) 文件。 *免责声明：该项目是出于教育目的而创建的。请尊重版权法，并仅使用此模块下载您有权合法访问的内容。*
